text:
maria-devx: Heads-up — ACME reported a 403 when trying to edit Project Settings right after they rotated an API key. Repro steps below, customer is blocked.

ryan-support: Can you paste the exact repro curl / SDK call and the response body?

maria-devx: Repro from their support VM (redacted keys):
```
curl -X POST \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_OLDKEY123' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_123/projects/proj_456/settings \ 
  -d '{"labels": {"env":"staging"}}'
```
Response: 403 Forbidden, body: `{ "error": "permission_denied", "reason": "key_not_found_or_aud_mismatch" }`

jess-admin: Quick question — was the user using a delegated token derived from the old key, or the primary API key directly? Hosted or Dedicated?

maria-devx: Hosted. They rotated the primary API key in Console. The CLI call above used a delegated SDK token that had been minted earlier (so it references the old key id).

ryan-support: That sounds like the token audit/lookup is failing after key rotation. I pulled auth logs — returning denies with `reason=key_not_found` and `aud=\"sk_live_OLDKEY123\"`. Snippet from auth service: ``[2026-05-11T12:47:02Z] authz: deny org=org_123 subj=token_abc reason=key_not_found key_id=OLDKEY123``
\
deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-824 (authz/manual-sync-request) — assigned to @sre-oncall

alex-eng: I can repro locally by rotating a key and then using an existing delegated token. Root cause: on-key-rotate we enqueue a background authz-sync job, but the job runs on a fixed cadence (6h) and there's no immediate rebind for delegated tokens. Delegated tokens still reference the old key id which auth service rejects after rotation.

maria-devx: Customer needs immediate restore of edit ability. Any quick workaround we can offer while we fix the flow?

alex-eng: Two options: (1) Customer creates a new API key and re-generates the delegated token (fastest). (2) We run a manual authz-sync for that org to refresh bindings (requires SRE).

ryan-support: I'll propose the manual sync and give instructions if they prefer doing keys: telling them to generate a new key is fine but they asked us to avoid rekeying mid-flight.

ryan-support: @sre-oncall can you run a manual authz sync for org_123? Command we use internally: `/admin authz-sync --org org_123 --force` (needs service account scope).

sre-oncall: On it. Running manual sync now. Will report back when finished. ETA ~3m.

[~180s later]

sre-oncall: authz-sync completed for org_123 — 12 bindings refreshed, 3 tokens re-bound. Post-sync smoke: api call returned 200 for the same delegated token. Logged under run_id=run_20260511_1745234050.

maria-devx: ✅ Just confirmed with the customer — they can edit Project Settings again. Thanks!

alex-eng: Follow-up action: create PS ticket PS-2384 to implement on-rotate hook that marks delegated tokens for immediate rebind and add a monitor for post-rotate auth failures. I'll pick this up.

maria-devx: Filing PS-2384 now and pinging customer success to coordinate. Closing loop once the ticket is live. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
